children: Vedanta Limited (NSE:VEDL) booked a Rs. 379 crore impairment in Q1 FY27 on Cambay block assets and receivables after ONGC took control of the block, where Vedanta held a 40% stake. Vedanta has appealed the Delhi High Court ruling, with hearings concluded and judgment reserved.
: After a July 22 court ruling, ONGC took control of the Cambay offshore block, where Vedanta held a 40% stake. Vedanta stopped booking revenue and expenses from the block.
: Vedanta (VEDL) booked a Rs. 379 crore impairment in Q1 FY27 on Cambay block assets and receivables, citing lost operational control, no valid production-sharing contract and uncertain recovery.
: Vedanta Limited (VEDL) appealed the Delhi High Court single-judge ruling to a division bench. Hearings in the appeal have concluded, and the judgment is reserved.
